notes:
REF-BM-02: No remote metadata collection is implemented.
REF-BM-03: Title is editable before and after saving, but description and automatic collection are absent.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, tags, and note are editable, but there is no description field.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate URLs create additional records; the response only reports the prior ID.
REF-BM-07: Items expose title and tags, but not description or favicon.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry is a plain text field without autocomplete.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, URL, and note but no description field exists.
REF-BM-14: The #tag query syntax is not parsed or supported.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators, grouping, and literal-operator quoting are unsupported.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases have no exact-phrase semantics.
REF-BM-17: No unread/read-later state exists.
REF-BM-18: No unread-only view exists.
REF-BM-19: Bookmarks cannot be marked read.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action interface.
REF-BM-21: No filtered-collection bulk action exists.
REF-BM-22: Results have one hard-coded newest-first order with no selectable sort key.
REF-BM-23: Notes can be written and displayed, but are escaped plain text rather than rendered Markdown.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML or PDF snapshot storage exists.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is absent.
REF-BM-26: No archival state or default-list exclusion exists.
REF-BM-27: Archive and reversible restoration are absent; only permanent deletion exists.
REF-BM-28: No archived-only list exists.
REF-BM-29: Bundles and reusable saved filters are absent.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is absent.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is absent.
REF-BM-32: No personal display settings are implemented.
